dependency_label: at least two sources targeted in the same region and report cycle; offline only
primary_gate: paired accuracy lower CI > 0 and hypothesis Brier lower, regret lower, and joint-label NLL lower than independent RCL
secondary_practical_target: at least 0.03 mean accuracy gain; not a gate chosen after test
marginal_projection: c_s(z)=q_s+(z-pi)*a_s; positive slopes fitted from training labels and capped to legal probabilities
secondary_temperature: separately calibrated on same seen-family validation cases
